ingredients.tip: Pat very dry for crisp skin
Crush lightly with the side of a knife

ingredients.text: Olive oil, salt, and black pepper

steps.text: Season the chicken aggressively with salt, pepper, and crushed fennel seed.
Sear skin-side down in a heavy skillet until deeply golden and the fat renders.
Turn the chicken, tuck in garlic and lemon halves, and brush everything with honey.
Roast until the chicken is cooked through and the lemons slump and caramelize.
Wilt the broccolini in the pan juices, then squeeze over the charred lemon.
